conditions.N1: The page opens (it parses, tags balanced)
conditions.N4: Every in-page link resolves; WhatsApp (wa.me) and tel: links are well formed
conditions.N5: Every charter fact appears exactly, and nothing is "to be confirmed"
conditions.N6: No invented content: every number, email and phone number on the page comes from the charter or the Requester's answers
conditions.N7: Every form has a submit control and a destination (action or mailto)
conditions.N8: A nav reaches every section, and the hero has one obvious main action
conditions.P1: All six sections are present and not empty
conditions.P2: Requirement ids are unique and sequential (R1, R2, ...)
conditions.P4: No invented facts: every number, email and proper name comes from the charter or the Requester's answers, or sits in an Assumption: line
conditions.P6: Every goal has a matching success metric
conditions.P7: Every user group named in the charter appears in Requirements or in a "no actions in this version" statement
conditions.P8: Each numeric success metric states its measurement window, or says "measurement window not set"
conditions.H1: All six sections are present and not empty
conditions.H3: Components have unique sequential ids (C1, C2, ...) and each states its responsibility
conditions.H4: Every PRD requirement appears in an HLD component
conditions.H5: No invented facts: every number, email and proper name comes from the charter, the Requester's answers or the PRD, or sits in an Assumption: line
conditions.H6: Nothing is "to be confirmed", and every brief fact appears exactly
conditions.L1: All five sections are present and not empty
conditions.L2: Section, element and field ids are unique, and every section has an id
conditions.L3: Every interactive element has a selector, a trigger and a behaviour
conditions.L4: Every form field has a name, a type and a required flag
conditions.L5: Every HLD component appears in an LLD section
conditions.L6: No invented facts: every number, email and proper name comes from the charter, the Requester's answers or the earlier documents, or sits in an Assumption: line

rubric.R-1: Consistent styling: the whole page follows the style guide (same fonts, colours, button and card styles)
rubric.R-2: Readable contrast: text is easy to read against its background (WCAG AA)
rubric.R-3: Clear hierarchy: one main heading, headings in order, the most important things stand out
rubric.R-4: One obvious main action: a visitor can tell at once what to do next
rubric.R-5: Easy navigation: a visitor can reach every section quickly, on a phone too
rubric.R-6: Tap targets are big enough on phones (at least 44x44px)
rubric.D-1: Every page section has an id and implements at least one component
rubric.D-2: Every interactive element has a selector, a trigger and a behaviour
rubric.D-3: Every form field has a type, a required flag and a validation rule
rubric.D-4: Consistent with the HLD: every component is built by a section
rubric.D-5: No invented facts: every fact comes from the brief or the Requester's answers or the earlier documents, or is labelled "Assumption:"; the evidence quotes each unlabelled claim
